title: Crash with invalid(?) extended array typehint check
body:
Looking at the wiki section on 'makeshift structs' typing I thought that maybe psalm could also support tuples in a similar way, so I tried the following:
```php
<?php

/**
 * @psalm-param array{int,string,bool} $b
 */
function a($b)
{

}
```
But with this input psalm crashes with the following output:
